details:
I personally believe that UGC content shouldn’t just be Private or Public, that there should be an Unlisted option and a Whitelisted option.

Private:

Actually private, like avatars currently are. 'Private' worlds shouldn't be accessible to anybody who happens to have the World ID to create any non-public instance they want.

Whitelisted:

Like Private, unless you have the assigned role in the assigned group. Users with the "Manage Whitelisted Assets" permission in a group can assign/unassign their uploaded Worlds/Avatars/etc to a role in a group. Anybody in that group and with that role would see the Asset like it's public, perhaps with an icon to show that it's role-specific.

Public Groups could have their own hub worlds, Private Groups could have their own secret hideouts. Groups with group-specific avatars can remove clunky password systems and just restrict their avatars to a role.

Unless you've tried to fake this using jankier systems, it feels like it would severely restrict what's publicly available on VRChat, but in truth this would save a lot of people a lot of jank and improve the quality of life of many groups.

Unlisted:

More like how 'private worlds' act right now. They don't appear on your user profile, don't appear in search results (including avatar search worlds if they check for it), but can otherwise be used and favorited by anybody.

Unlisted is useful for avatars you're supposed to find, avatars that are prizes or secrets, hidden world elements of puzzles and ARGs, alternate variants like holiday versions and historical versions that don't clutter author profiles without limiting what players can do them.

Public:

Public. Everyone can see it, everyone can favorite it, everyone can search for it, everyone can use it. The most common state because most people want the most people to have what they made.

Worlds that are currently private would become unlisted, it's not perfect but it's the best match.

Anything I couldn't think of right away will be in the comments, please read them!
title: Extend Private and Public to also have Unlisted and Whitelist options
